boarding_points.name: Terminal Hidroviário de Porto Alegre (Cais Mauá, Armazém B3)
boarding_points.operator: CatSul (Grupo Ouro e Prata) / Portos RS waterfront
boarding_points.notes: CatSul's main Porto Alegre hidroviária at Av. Mauá 1050, beside Armazém B3 with free parking; daily departures to Guaíba and Píer Pontal. Address confirmed on catsul.com.br.
boarding_points.source: https://www.catsul.com.br/ + OpenStreetMap (amenity=ferry_terminal 'Terminal Hidroviário de Porto Alegre')

boarding_points.name: Cais Embarcadero (Cais Mauá waterfront complex)
boarding_points.linked_locale: Porto Alegre (Centro Histórico / Gasômetro end of Cais Mauá)
boarding_points.operator: Cais Embarcadero (leisure complex); CatSul calls on weekends and during events
boarding_points.notes: Revitalised waterfront leisure complex; CatSul operates weekend embarkations and special event stops here (e.g. South Summit Brazil, Mar 2026). Coordinates from OSM/Nominatim for the Cais Embarcadero complex.
boarding_points.source: https://www.catsul.com.br/ (South Summit 2026 notice) + Nominatim/OSM 'Cais Embarcadero, Porto Alegre'

boarding_points.name: Usina do Gasômetro / Marina Municipal Comodoro Edmundo Soares
boarding_points.operator: Prefeitura de Porto Alegre (municipal marina); Usina do Gasômetro cultural centre adjacent
boarding_points.notes: Public marina at the foot of the Usina do Gasômetro (-30.03408,-51.24109 per Nominatim), the city's sunset landmark. Natural anchor for sunset-run departures.
boarding_points.source: OpenStreetMap (leisure=marina 'Marina Municipal Comodoro Edmundo Soares') + Nominatim 'Usina do Gasômetro'

boarding_points.name: Píer Pontal (Pontal Shopping / Parque do Pontal)
boarding_points.linked_locale: Porto Alegre (Praia de Belas / Pontal district)
boarding_points.notes: Scheduled CatSul stop (15 min to Guaíba per operator FAQ); ticket office on site; parking at Pontal Shopping. Parque do Pontal inaugurated Nov 2022.

boarding_points.name: Píer BarraShoppingSul
boarding_points.notes: Shopping-centre pier immediately south of Píer Pontal on the Orla; leisure/berth spur mapped in OSM as ferry terminal.

boarding_points.name: Veleiros do Sul (sailing marina, Assunção)
boarding_points.notes: Historic sailing club and largest marina cluster on the Porto Alegre shore of the lake (alongside Clube dos Jangadeiros and Sava Clube); premium-charter and charging-backbone candidate.

boarding_points.name: Clube dos Jangadeiros (marina, Tristeza)
boarding_points.notes: Major Zona Sul sailing club marina, directly across the lake from Guaíba town; southern anchor of the marina arc.

boarding_points.name: Terminal Hidroviário de Guaíba
boarding_points.notes: CatSul's Guaíba hidroviária at Av. João Pessoa 966, Centro (address per catsul.com.br), with public parking in front; western terminus of the daily crossing.

boarding_points.name: Marina da Conga (Ilha da Pintada, Delta do Jacuí)
boarding_points.linked_locale: Porto Alegre (Ilha da Pintada / Delta do Jacuí)
boarding_points.notes: Verified marina on Ilha da Pintada, the delta's fishing-village island (Z-5 colony, waterfront restaurants). Serves as the delta-spur boarding node pending survey of the village's public landings.

boarding_points.name: Ilha da Pintada village waterfront (Z-5 fishing colony landings)
boarding_points.linked_locale: Porto Alegre (Ilha da Pintada / Delta do Jacuí)
boarding_points.operator: Colônia de Pescadores Z-5 / informal landings
boarding_points.notes: The village has multiple small boat landings used by fishers and restaurant traffic ('sirga'-style local boats referenced in prior scan), but no single official passenger pier could be verified to coordinate precision — left null rather than guessed; field survey required.
boarding_points.source: unverified — prior scan finding, no authoritative coordinate found

boarding_points.name: Eldorado do Sul waterway terminal (planned resilience route)
boarding_points.operator: Prefeitura de Eldorado do Sul / Metroplan (route under study)
boarding_points.notes: R$5.2M dredging underway since Dec 2025 to enable an Eldorado do Sul–Porto Alegre waterway resilience/transport route; terminal site not yet published — coordinates null until the pier location is official.
